---
title: "Replication of Table 4 (review-volume columns 3 and 4)"
subtitle: "Zhu, Shi and Banerjee (2025), Management Science"
output: html_document
---

This document replicates the review-volume columns (3) and (4) of Table 4: monthly ratings of a book after its giveaway, before and after the January 2018 fee. Columns (1) and (2), on the average rating, are not replicated. Knit it from RStudio or run `rmarkdown::render("code/replication_table4.Rmd")` in the repository root. The setup chunk sets the working directory of all chunks to the repository root, so the paths below start there.

The data have about 12.6 million rows and need a few GB of memory.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "..")
library(data.table)
library(lfe)
```

## Data

Book-month panel of the number of ratings `N`, 12 months before and after the giveaway.

```{r data}
reviews <- readRDS("data/demand/review_vol_yearmon.Rds")
reviews <- reviews[abs(diff_month) <= 12]
```

## Regressions

`post_giveaway` is 1 in the months after the book's giveaway. `post_mon` is 1 if the giveaway took place after the fee (from January 2018).

$$
N_{it} = \beta_1 \, \text{post\_giveaway}_{it} + \beta_2 \, \text{post\_giveaway}_{it} \times \text{post\_mon}_i + \alpha_i + \mu_{\text{yearmon}} + \varepsilon_{it}
$$

The `felm` syntax is `y ~ regressors | fixed effects | instruments (none) | cluster`.

Column (3) has only `post_giveaway`; column (4) adds the interaction.

```{r models}
m3 <- felm(N ~ post_giveaway | book_id + yearmon | 0 | book_id, data = reviews)
m4 <- felm(N ~ post_giveaway + post_giveaway:post_mon | book_id + yearmon | 0 | book_id, data = reviews)
```

## Results

The results are saved to `results/replication_table4/`.

```{r save, results = "asis"}
dir.create("results/replication_table4", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
c3 <- coef(summary(m3))
c4 <- coef(summary(m4))
fwrite(rbind(data.table(model = "(3)", term = rownames(c3), c3, N = m3$N, adj_R2 = summary(m3)$adj.r.squared),
             data.table(model = "(4)", term = rownames(c4), c4, N = m4$N, adj_R2 = summary(m4)$adj.r.squared)),
       "results/replication_table4/table4.csv")

a <- "post_giveaway"
b <- "post_giveaway:post_mon"
table4 <- c(
  "# Table 4: Effect of Giveaway and Monetization on Review Volume",
  "",
  "Dependent variable: number of ratings per book and month, 12 months before and after the giveaway.",
  "",
  "| | (3) | (4) |",
  "|:--|:-:|:-:|",
  sprintf("| Post Giveaway | %.3f (%.3f) | %.3f (%.3f) |", c3[a, 1], c3[a, 2], c4[a, 1], c4[a, 2]),
  sprintf("| Post Giveaway x Post Monetization | | %.3f (%.3f) |", c4[b, 1], c4[b, 2]),
  sprintf("| Number of books | %s | %s |", format(uniqueN(reviews$book_id), big.mark = ","), format(uniqueN(reviews$book_id), big.mark = ",")),
  sprintf("| Mean rating count | %.2f | %.2f |", mean(reviews$N), mean(reviews$N)),
  "| Book fixed effects | Yes | Yes |",
  "| Year-month fixed effects | Yes | Yes |",
  sprintf("| Observations | %s | %s |", format(m3$N, big.mark = ","), format(m4$N, big.mark = ",")),
  sprintf("| Adjusted R2 | %.3f | %.3f |", summary(m3)$adj.r.squared, summary(m4)$adj.r.squared),
  "",
  "Standard errors clustered by book in parentheses."
)
writeLines(table4, "results/replication_table4/table4.md")
cat(sub("^# ", "### ", table4), sep = "\n")
```
